title: Notice
description: A transient, nonterminal observation for clients and the next model packet. A Notice is never operation-failure truth and cannot determine durable history, lifecycle, scheduling, or recovery. Producers use the open `source` + `kind` discriminator; clients render the producer-owned `level` without inferring semantics from kind names.

source.description: Producer identifier. Top-level for self-contained subsystems; colon-namespaced for parameterized producers such as `provider:openai` or `exec:search`.

kind.description: Open discriminator within a source. Examples include `grammar_unenforced`, `embed_progress`, `search_progress`, and `turn_awaiting_model`.

level.description: Display severity set by the producer. It does not make the Notice a durable operation result.

position.description: Optional typed position for an observation. ContentOffset points into model output; LogCoordinate points at a durable log row without replacing it.

op.description: Optional op token (FIND/READ/EDIT/...) at the coordinate, for human-readable rendering.
